unit_tests.scope: existing suite plus four suspension edge-case regressions

verified: inactive runtime is not started by suspension
freezer command failure and timeout do not prevent opening sign-in
thaw failure does not prevent desktop activation
swiping current card thaws without freezing again
systemd service freeze suspends both parent and spawned child counters
cgroup.events reports frozen 1; both counters remain unchanged for one second
user-manager commands remain responsive while runtime cgroup is frozen
both counters resume increasing after thaw

runtime_source.finding: napplet exec.Command uses Setpgid; no separate systemd scope in this launcher, so cgroup ancestry is inherited

limitations: VM uses counter stand-ins rather than a real WebKit game
real-game graphics, audio, GPU activity and long-idle recovery remain unverified
freeze/thaw failures are logged and desktop switching continues; resource suspension and game resume are not guaranteed after a systemd failure
